integrity_statement: Analytic proof and reproducible exact-rational checks are included. Computational tests do not establish all-parameter assertions. Novelty assessed against inspected public literature but exhaustive historical priority is not established.
scientific_limitations: Planar normal strongly monotone operator, identical odd scalar response in both coordinates, fixed positive stepsize and exact arithmetic. Strict-step convergence only; no convergence assertion at the sharp Fejer endpoint, and no higher-dimensional or noisy generalization.
title: A universal sharp skewness boundary for separable saturated forward iterations
